Ava: Quick brainstorm: small PLG test that bundles a short benchmark story, a 20-min demo webinar, and a 72h credit drip + 3 prompt templates. KPI: +12-15% activation.

Jamal: Love it. Webinar should highlight p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens vs a mainstream alternative.

Priya: Keep copy product-focused. I'll prep 3 persona packs (productivity, support, search).

Luca: Flow idea: give 150 starter tokens at signup; attendees get +150. A/B test immediate vs gated credits.

Maya: Microcopy variants ready: credits-first and templates-first. I'll draft email cadence (invite, reminder, last chance).

campaign-bot: Campaign created: `seed_surge_apr2026`. Reminders scheduled: -48h, -24h, -1h.

Jamal: Perf sheet: https://redwood.internal/perf/seed-surge (internal). Use 'slides' tab.

Priya: I'll build two slides: chat latency and embed throughput + cost. Need a short pilot quote.

Luca: Engineering: one-click prompt import to Playground improves time-to-success. Jamal: is the import manifest done?

Jamal: Yes, manifest accepted. Example: `{ "name": "support-quick", "prompts": ["Summarize ticket","Draft reply"] }`. We can enable it for the test.

Ava: Action items: Ava finalize brief/KPIs; Maya emails + copy; Priya slides + packs; Jamal perf + import; Luca in-app banner. Sync 15m tomorrow. Launch window Apr 12-18.

Maya: I'll attach a tiny GIF for the in-app banner.

Ava: Drop any copy here by 4pm. Excited to test whether templates + credits speed activation. :rocket:
